methodBoundary: Five anti-cases were frozen before theory coding; adjudication occurs after source lock, primary Pass B, independent coding and replay freeze.

cases.finding: The relational model succeeds by hiding physical execution choices, not by eliminating them. Representation/reality separation therefore does not imply weaker abstraction; a high-level representation can be valuable precisely when a competent hidden executor binds it to physical reality.

A stable interoperable standard can dominate continuous local optimization when network effects, roaming and supplier scale matter. Conditionality concerns regime/world dependence, not perpetual method switching inside a coordination regime.

A temporary pause and risk-tiered containment can expand long-run searchable/admissible space by preserving legitimacy and reducing catastrophic downside. Governance overhead is not automatically anti-progress, but its value remains consequence- and evidence-dependent.

The locally highest-energy rechargeable architecture lost because dendrite/fire and cycle-life failures dominated commercial consequence. Lower local performance on one axis can be globally superior once repeated operation and safety are inside the objective.

A coordinated general-intelligence research program can fail its declared whole-system objective while leaving useful subsystem knowledge and competitive stimulus. Whole-program failure and component option value must not be collapsed in either direction.

falsifiabilityFinding: Six historical epochs still produce no clean adjudicated direct contradiction. This increases confirmation-bias pressure rather than warranting universality; the large HD6 coder disagreement and scaffold sensitivity are evidence against treating the frozen vocabulary as a final ontology.
